end_to_end_latency_ms.method: Unavailable: no correlated sender/receiver probe and clock error bound.

telemetry_latency_ms.method: Unavailable: DDS timestamps are offset-adjusted; no independently validated clock mapping.

command_latency_ms.method: Unavailable: ACK records lack a unique request identifier; no independently validated correlation.

packet_loss_pct.method: Unavailable: no identifiable transmitted transport packet/sequence denominator.

rx_payload_mbps.method: Sum received ROS CDR bytes * 8 / whole monotonic run duration / 1e6; excludes transport headers.

tx_payload_mbps.method: Sum local publish-call CDR bytes * 8 / whole monotonic run duration / 1e6; delivery unconfirmed.

bandwidth_mbps.method: Unavailable: no wire capture or physical link-capacity measurement. Payload throughput is reported separately.

node_cpu_pct.method: Arithmetic mean of finite primed psutil process CPU interval samples; process can exceed 100%.

system_cpu_pct.method: Arithmetic mean of finite psutil WSL guest CPU interval samples; excludes Windows host/QGC/GPU.

node_rss_mib.method: Arithmetic mean of mission-process resident bytes / 2^20, measured at resource callbacks.

mission_completion_s.method: Logger monotonic initialization to terminal result, including preflight; successful active missions only.

attempt_duration_s.method: Logger monotonic initialization to terminal result, including failed/passive attempts; not successful mission completion.

energy_wh.method: Physical UAV energy unavailable in SITL; simulated battery estimates are not physical energy.

power_w.method: Physical UAV power unavailable; requires calibrated battery current/voltage or external power analyzer.

end_to_end_latency_ms.method: Unavailable: no correlated sender/receiver probe and clock error bound.

telemetry_latency_ms.method: Unavailable: DDS timestamps are offset-adjusted; no independently validated clock mapping.

command_latency_ms.method: Unavailable: ACK records lack a unique request identifier; no independently validated correlation.

packet_loss_pct.method: Unavailable: no identifiable transmitted transport packet/sequence denominator.

rx_payload_mbps.method: Sum received ROS CDR bytes * 8 / whole monotonic run duration / 1e6; excludes transport headers.

tx_payload_mbps.method: Sum local publish-call CDR bytes * 8 / whole monotonic run duration / 1e6; delivery unconfirmed.

bandwidth_mbps.method: Unavailable: no wire capture or physical link-capacity measurement. Payload throughput is reported separately.

node_cpu_pct.method: Arithmetic mean of finite primed psutil process CPU interval samples; process can exceed 100%.

system_cpu_pct.method: Arithmetic mean of finite psutil WSL guest CPU interval samples; excludes Windows host/QGC/GPU.

node_rss_mib.method: Arithmetic mean of mission-process resident bytes / 2^20, measured at resource callbacks.

mission_completion_s.method: Logger monotonic initialization to terminal result, including preflight; successful active missions only.

attempt_duration_s.method: Logger monotonic initialization to terminal result, including failed/passive attempts; not successful mission completion.

energy_wh.method: Physical UAV energy unavailable in SITL; simulated battery estimates are not physical energy.

power_w.method: Physical UAV power unavailable; requires calibrated battery current/voltage or external power analyzer.
